articles.summary: I’m one of the co-founders of camelAI, and we just announced we’re open-sourcing the platform. Here’s the full story: why we built it cloud-first, how it compares to Claude Cowork and OpenWork, and what open source actually means for teams that want to vibe-code and share what they build.
articles.title: camelAI Is Going Open Source — Here’s Why

articles.summary: I’m the non-technical COO at camelAI. A few months ago, Illiana told me I needed to learn how to vibe code. Here’s the honest story of my journey through Cursor, Lovable, and camelAI - including the time I accidentally deleted our production app.
articles.title: I tried Cursor, Lovable, and camelAI before finding a vibe coding tool I could actually use
